fixtures.behavior: Skip a later JSON object whose normalized EntityID duplicates an earlier valid EntityID.
fixtures.expected: One accepted record with EntityID 1001; DuplicateJsonEntityIds is 1.

fixtures.behavior: Reject empty, non-digit, and non-object JSON Data entries as missing or invalid EntityIDs.
fixtures.expected: Only EntityID 1002 is accepted; MissingOrInvalidEntityIds is 3.

fixtures.behavior: Apply the requested filter by exact equality after textual normalization.
fixtures.expected: With filter Group=alpha, only EntityID 1003 is accepted; FilteredOutRecords is 1.

fixtures.behavior: Normalize a JSON null field value to an empty text value before output mapping.
fixtures.expected: OptionalText is rendered as empty text for the accepted record.
fixtures.outside_v1: V1 preserves null-versus-empty distinctions; no fixed logical operation converts canonical null to empty text.

fixtures.behavior: Fail when a top-level Data array is absent.
fixtures.outside_v1: This is JSON reader root-shape validation, not one of the ten logical operations.

fixtures.behavior: Fail when the top-level Data array is truncated.
fixtures.expected: Parse failure before records are emitted.
fixtures.outside_v1: This is JSON reader parse failure behavior, not one of the ten logical operations.

fixtures.behavior: Read a top-level Data array through fixed 4 MiB chunks.
fixtures.expected: Chunking is externally reported only through successful processing of an input crossing a 4 MiB boundary.
fixtures.outside_v1: The fixed 4 MiB reader-buffer policy is not a logical operation and V1 does not specify that exact chunk size.

fixtures.behavior: Derive a supported output column from a recognized input field selected by an existing CSV header.
fixtures.expected: The selected recognized value appears under the existing requested header.

fixtures.behavior: Compose an address from street, city, and house fallbacks while dropping blank or zero-only house numbers.
fixtures.expected: The selected address text contains no blank or zero-only house-number component.
fixtures.outside_v1: The fixed catalog has no multi-column concatenation, conditional fallback, or derived-column operation.

fixtures.behavior: Emit blank values in both phone output columns.
fixtures.expected: Both requested phone cells are empty for every accepted record.
fixtures.outside_v1: The catalog has no add-column or unconditional constant-assignment operation.

fixtures.behavior: Emit a blank value for an unrecognized existing CSV header.
fixtures.expected: The unrecognized output column is present and empty.
fixtures.outside_v1: The catalog cannot create an output column populated with a constant blank.

fixtures.behavior: Number appended CSV rows from the last existing CSV index.
fixtures.expected: The next appended row receives index 8.
fixtures.outside_v1: Requires reading and appending to an existing output plus row-number generation; V1 has one source, one new output, and no sequence operation.

fixtures.behavior: Trim entity-id lines, remove a trailing comma, drop invalid values, collapse duplicates, and rewrite the entity-id file.
fixtures.expected: The rewritten entity-id content contains only one 1008 and one 0000; InvalidEntityIdLinesRemoved is 1.
fixtures.outside_v1: Although trim, filter, and deduplicate resemble logical operations, this behavior needs a second source and rewrites it; V1 requires one immutable source and one new output.

fixtures.behavior: In ids-only mode, omit CSV output while updating entity IDs.
fixtures.outside_v1: V1 successful workflows publish exactly one new declared output and do not support this mode-dependent omitted output.

fixtures.behavior: In dry-run mode, write neither CSV nor entity-id output.
fixtures.outside_v1: V1 has no dry-run execution mode that suppresses its required single output publication.

fixtures.behavior: Fail for missing parent/input paths and invalid CSV-path mode or incomplete filter arguments.
fixtures.expected: Argument or path validation failure before output changes.
fixtures.outside_v1: This is command-line argument and path-mode validation, not a fixed logical operation.

fixtures.behavior: Return the named cleanup counters, paths, mode, and filter fields in the report.
fixtures.expected: The report exposes every field listed in the task 1.8 inventory.
fixtures.outside_v1: V1 RunReport does not define this exact cleanup-specific report schema, and logical operations do not own report assembly.

fixtures.behavior: Remove temporary files on terminal completion.
fixtures.expected: No cleanup-script temporary file remains after success or failure.
fixtures.outside_v1: This is Writer finalization/resource cleanup behavior, not a fixed logical operation.
